card.name: Word after a money amount
card.fires_on: The word right after a sum of money, such as 'dollar' or 'dollars' after '$28 million', or a linking word like 'on' or 'for' after a spent or funded amount.

modes.label: Dollar after amount
modes.description: The word dollar(s) following a figure like '$15 million'.
modes.example: a $185 million<< dollar>> expansion added a signature outpatient building

modes.label: Spending preposition
modes.description: On or for right after an amount or the verbs spent, provided, or funding.
modes.example: spent $500<< on>> a genetic test for her autistic son
